source: Written from the code at 33d6f314, which is the definition of a one-voice project's take digests.
rule: A digest here that moves means a one-voice project buys every take again. Each case's config and environ may be rewritten into a new config shape that states the same voice, and its digests never change.

script:
## 1. Two friends

[Scene 1. A dark stage. The street map is not there yet. Two dots, then the city, then the gap between them, then the texts that go nowhere.]

Two friends, [beat] one city, [beat] forty minutes apart. [beat] So they text, [beat] and they never meet.

## 2. The map

The map fills in, street by street. [pause 2] Then the gap closes. [beat] They meet halfway.

## 3. Again

The map fills in, street by street. [pause 2] Then the gap closes. [beat] They meet halfway.
